run_name: Harbor Point heat and stormwater resilience concept note
template_name: GCF SAP concept note (section structure simplified for the golden set)

chapter_schema.title: Project summary
chapter_schema.description: Project title, city and country, accredited entity, executing entities, total cost and GCF funding requested, and project duration.
required_fields: total cost and GCF funding requested

chapter_schema.title: Climate rationale and baseline
chapter_schema.description: Climate hazards and observed trends, exposed people and assets, and baseline conditions without the project.

chapter_schema.title: Project components and activities
chapter_schema.description: Components, activities, quantified outputs and their locations.

chapter_schema.title: Expected results and indicators
chapter_schema.description: Expected adaptation results, beneficiaries, and indicators with baselines and targets.

chapter_schema.title: Implementation arrangements
chapter_schema.description: Implementing entities and partners with their roles, governance, and monitoring and reporting.

chapter_schema.title: Indicative financing
chapter_schema.description: Total cost by component, co-financing, the amount and financial instrument requested from GCF, and the cost basis.

required_fields: total cost and GCF funding requested
